sampling.retrieval: 20 predeclared targets: two fixed-seed candidates per recording, four categories of five
sampling.moments: one fixed-seed sample per short/medium/long bucket for each recording; fallback to remaining pool if a bucket is empty
sampling.clips: the first five unique production Rank-1 results in fixed retrieval-case order, five fixed-seed random FINAL Moments, five highest deterministic boundary-difficulty scores
